description: Development and supply-chain security rules mapped to Legion package and AI threat data

rules.title: Vulnerable Direct Dependency
rules.description: Direct package dependencies with known CVE/OSV findings in Cargo, npm, or pip inventory.
rules.remediation: Run `cargo update`, `npm audit fix`, or `pip install --upgrade`. Pin to patched versions. Check changelogs.

rules.title: Malicious AI SDK Package
rules.description: A malicious or typosquatted AI framework package detected in the environment.
rules.remediation: Remove the malicious package immediately. Rotate any credentials that may have been exposed. Audit imports.

rules.title: Typosquatted Package
rules.description: A package name closely resembling a legitimate library was detected — possible supply chain attack.
rules.remediation: Remove the package. Verify all dependency names against official registries. Implement package name validation.

rules.title: YARA-Matched Source Artifact
rules.description: YARA rules matched files in the scanned code or package tree — potential backdoor or malicious artifact.
rules.remediation: Inspect YARA-matched files. Compare against known-good versions. Audit recent dependency updates.

rules.title: Active CVE Match in Installed Package
rules.description: An installed package version directly matches a CVE or CISA Known Exploited Vulnerability entry.
rules.remediation: Patch immediately to fixed version. Check CISA KEV for exploitation status. Apply virtual patching if patch unavailable.

rules.title: Vulnerable AI Framework in Production
rules.description: A production AI/ML framework (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, etc.) with known CVE is running.
rules.remediation: Update AI framework to patched version. Review AI agent permissions and data access. Sandbox AI workloads.

rules.title: New Package Outside Baseline
rules.description: A package was added to the environment outside the established baseline snapshot.
rules.remediation: Verify the new package is authorized. Check its OSV/NPM advisory status. Update baseline if legitimate.

rules.title: Vulnerable Dependency Alert
rules.description: A vulnerable transitive or direct dependency was flagged by the alert engine.
rules.remediation: Identify the dependency chain. Update the root dependency. Consider dependency review in CI/CD pipeline.

rules.title: npm/pip Worm-Style AI Package Intelligence
rules.description: AI threat intelligence indicates worm-style npm or pip package behavior: lifecycle execution, impersonation, credential theft, or dependency propagation.
hunt_steps: Inspect lifecycle scripts and package archive
rules.remediation: Remove the package, freeze dependency graph, rotate exposed tokens, clear package caches, and rebuild from trusted lockfiles.

rules.title: Package Install Path Traversal Heuristic
rules.description: Local telemetry indicates path traversal, archive-slip, or out-of-tree writes during package installation or build execution.
rules.check_value: path traversal|directory traversal|zip slip|tar slip|write outside|../|..\|node_modules/../|site-packages/../|package extracted outside
rules.remediation: Restore overwritten files from trusted media, remove the package tree, and enforce path normalization before extraction.

rules.title: Package Manager Credential Access Heuristic
rules.description: Local telemetry indicates npm/pip package or lifecycle script access to environment variables, package tokens, SSH keys, cloud keys, or AI API keys.
hunt_steps: Map process tree to package source
rules.remediation: Rotate exposed secrets, isolate package install environments, and prevent secret injection into untrusted install/build scripts.
